title: THE WHEEL HAS EIGHT FIXED SLOTS
why: His answer: a fixed eight-slot ring. The item wheel is now always the same eight slots in the same places, so your hand learns them. Clockwise from the top: medkit, frag charge, smoke canister, decoy beacon, armour plate, tripwire mine, stim injector, bandage. Throwables are on the right, medical on the left, the plate underneath. Whatever you carry, in the backpack or the pouch, fills its slot by itself, so there is nothing to set up. A type you have none of keeps its slot, dimmed with a 0, and letting go on it takes nothing out and says so. DEMO and CAREER are the same. The hint line above the ring also moved a little closer to it so it stays off the extraction timer.
now: The item wheel now has eight fixed slots, and an empty one shows dim with a 0.
